outcome: Total quantitative blood loss during cesarean section
cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with abnormally invasive placenta (AIP) grade 4 and 5 by ultrasonography during cesarean section
finding: Subendometrial vasopressin injection significantly reduced blood loss during cesarean section and hysterectomy in women with AIP compared to controls.
mod_finding: This study investigated the effects of subendometrial vasopressin injection on blood loss in patients with abnormally invasive placenta undergoing cesarean section and hysterectomy.
